segments.summary: one product-UI layout on black: 2-line extended-caps headline slides in from opposite edges with blur and glow, flare streaks with sparkle heads park at the line ends, line 1 morphs into a size taper; camera dives with a one-picture snap zoom onto an input pill that fills with luminous pixel squares, a prompt types on, the first option chip pops in alone, snap zoom onto it; each clicked chip presses x0.81-0.83 and springs back as its menu opens (chip 2 slides in during the menu-1 pull-back x0.60), the chosen row presses x0.79-0.81 and springs back and the chip label swaps on the deepest picture; each menu close is a vertical camera whip-tilt (the first chained straight into a horizontal whip pan to chip 2), menu 2 opens with a pure tilt; an accelerating rise into a snap zoom-out to the whole card, 3D camera swing toward a 3D button, chunky 3D cursor flies in, dives and presses it, tile burst, push-in + horizontal flare bloom into a hard cut

one footage shot (camera moves inside it, no cut) with two white kinetic captions in its first half: 2-line staircase then 3-line staircase stepping up-right, characters blur-fade in left to right, blocks drift at a constant -6 px/frame, lines fade out first in first out; footage only from f1246 (checked on sheets/overview_01248-01293.jpg, sheets/overview_01296-01341.jpg, sheets/overview_01344-01389.jpg)

dark title card: a flare streak grows from the left edge, a 1-word line rides it in from the right and a 2-word line slides in from the left (caps, centred), two sparkle stars fly from the line ends to opposite corners in step, three glossy logo spheres fly in and settle under the headline while it lifts and compacts into tapered lines, then the spheres fall and the camera whip-tilts down after them; behind everything a faint wireframe of orbit ellipses tumbles continuously

prompt-box UI arriving from below at the end of the whip: the falling spheres drop onto the chip row, merge into one glow that shrinks to a point and vanishes while the camera pushes in x1.15, a prompt types on, the camera pulls back to the landing framing, whip-pans to the right end of the box (the jump picture also pushes in x1.25 and lifts the card 13.2% H) and opens a 2-option mode dropdown whose selection (the chosen option presses x0.85 and springs back) swaps the mode label; continues into v5c3 (menu collapses f1615-f1623)
